visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a gray short-sleeved jumpsuit and a blue baseball cap stands in a brightly lit industrial-style exhibition space. He gestures with his hands while addressing the camera directly. The background features long wooden tables displaying various metallic tools and large banners with Japanese text and graphics of cutlery. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of a pair of silver locking pliers held by the man. He uses his finger to point out a specialized small hole at the tip of the jaws, then demonstrates gripping a stripped screw on a metal block to show how the tool functions effectively. (3) The man displays a black multi-tool that combines a hammer head with pliers. He holds it up, demonstrating its grip and explaining its use for camping. He playfully mimics a defensive pose, suggesting its use if one encounters a bear, followed by a bright yellow screen transition with text overlays. (4) A long, 150cm vernier caliper is shown lying on a wooden table under warm studio lighting. The man picks up the large instrument to emphasize its massive scale, showing its length relative to the table, followed by another rapid yellow graphic transition. (5) On a table, several stainless steel bowls of varying sizes are displayed. The man nudges a bowl, demonstrating its weighted 'tumbler' characteristic where it rocks but does not tip over. He then fits several mesh lids and smaller plates onto the bowls, showing how they nest perfectly together. (6) A quick montage shows various spoons, saws, and vibrant, rainbow-colored titanium cups on display. The final scene returns to a wide shot of the man in the exhibition hall, standing between display tables, with banners showing event dates and inviting viewers to attend.

(5) Multiple rhythmic thuds and metallic clinks are heard as the man demonstrates the bowls rocking on the table and nesting lids.
